legendHelp: Controls the display name used in the chart legend, tooltip, and table rows for each series.
legendCustomHelp: Custom: enter a name manually. You can use $label or Grafana-style templates to read labels returned by the metric.
legendAutoHelp: Auto: builds the name from metric labels, for example {svc_name="api", endpoint="/checkout"}.
legendDisplayHelp: Controls the legend below the chart. List shows names only; Table also shows min, max, and mean values.
warningThresholdHelp: Draws a yellow reference line on line, area, and bar charts to show when values approach the risk range. Leave empty to hide it.
criticalThresholdHelp: Draws a red reference line on line, area, and bar charts to show when values enter the critical range. Leave empty to hide it.
variableDeleteAllowed: This variable is not referenced by queries and can be deleted.
variableDeleteBlocked: This variable is used by {{count}} queries. Remove those references before deleting it.
labelsAvailableAfterQuery: Configure widget metric queries to select labels.
supportedParametersHelp: These are resource filters the dashboard recognizes. Click one to insert its PromQL matcher.
recognizedParametersHelp: These labels already map to dashboard filters and follow the selected filter values.
fixedFiltersHelp: These conditions are written directly in PromQL. They do not appear in the dashboard filter bar and do not require user selection.
unrecognizedParametersHelp: These labels are ordinary PromQL metric labels for now. Configure a dashboard variable if they should become selectable filters.
noVariablePermission: No data permission for this variable
emptyCanvasHint: Add a widget first, configure it on the right, then place it on the canvas.
addWidgetPlaceholderHint: New widgets open in the config panel first and are placed after confirmation.
unsupportedWidgetHelp: This widget type was removed. Delete it or change it to a supported chart type.
widgetDeferredSuggestion: This panel will load when it enters the viewport.
syntaxErrorSuggestion: Check the PromQL syntax near the reported position.
timeoutSuggestion: Narrow the time range or simplify the query, then retry.
tooLargeSuggestion: Reduce the time range, increase the step, or narrow the query result.
noPermissionSuggestion: Select an allowed data group or contact an administrator.
metricMissingSuggestion: Verify the metric name and labels exist in the selected time range.
noDataSuggestion: Adjust the time range or variable values and refresh.
queryFailureSuggestion: Review the query and retry after the metric service recovers.
